events.verdict: Siakam (IND) maintains a legal guarding position during Murray's (NOP) drive to the basket.
Williamson (NOP) moves laterally into Haliburton (IND) during his driving shot attempt and the contact initiated is more than marginal.
Siakam (IND) establishes himself in a screening position in Fears' (NOP) path prior to the contact.
Fears (NOP) avoids making contact with Siakam's (IND) arm during his jump shot attempt.
Murray (NOP) makes legal contact to the ball to dislodge it from Zubac's (IND) possession.
Murray (NOP) reaches in and makes illegal contact to Jackson's (IND) head/face.
Nembhard (IND) jumps vertically and absorbs the ensuing contact with Williamson (NOP).
Nembhard (IND) gathers the ball and legally takes two steps. Although he drags his back foot, he never plants it for a third step.
Oubre Jr. (IND) legally contests Fears' (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Missi (NOP) makes contact to the ball to knock it loose and the contact with Zubac (IND) is incidental.
Missi (NOP) commits a take foul on Zubac (IND).
